title: Dopamyn
tagline: The infrastrucuture for autonomous performance based creator marketing
description:
Dopamyn is building the AI marketing brain for brands.

We are starting with a fair, automated creator marketplace where brands reward meaningful engagement and creators get paid instantly for the value they create.

That’s our foundation. But the bigger vision is to offer Dopamyn to every brand as their personalized marketing agency, one that is entirely run by AI Agents. Brands will set a goal or budget, and Dopamyn agents will plan and execute the entire campaign automatically whether it’s a quest for engagement, a mindshare push, a raid campaign, a content thread, or a UGC video wave.

Over time, our AI will decide what kind of campaign to run, which creators to activate, and how much to pay them, all powered by real-time on-chain proof and LLM-driven contextual intelligence.

In short: Dopamyn is building the infrastructure for autonomous, performance-based marketing where every action is measurable, and every creator is paid instantly for real impact.

Dopamyn is the next evolution of the creator economy, just as the ad market grew to trillions over the last 20 years, and we had numerous services that made it efficient and targeted. Similarly, the creator economy needs a system that tracks creator activity in real-time, evaluates the context using AI, assigns a fair financial value, and instantly settles the payments. This is only possible now after LLMs and Blockchain have evolved to go mainstream and accessible for all.

In the long run, Dopamyn becomes every brand’s AI marketing agency — taking budgets, planning campaigns across platforms, activating the right creators, and optimizing spend in real time. Marketing that’s transparent, intelligent, and self-driving — powered by creators, verified on-chain.
how_its_made:
We built Dopamyn as a fully on-chain rewards distribution engine designed for high-volume, low-cost creator reward programs on Base.

A. Architecture & Tech Stack

1. Smart Contracts (Base)
All reward distribution logic is deployed on Base, enabling fast, low-cost settlement for thousands of micro-rewards.
Contracts handle campaign creation, reward allocation, batching, and secure verification of eligible participants.

2. Backend & Services:
A Node.js / TypeScript backend orchestrates campaigns, wallet connections, verifications, and reward settlements. We use PostgreSQL to store campaign metadata, attribution data, and activity logs.
Background workers handle:
indexing on-chain events
validating user actions
constructing Merkle trees for batch payout proofs
executing scheduled reward settlements on Base.

3. Frontend
Our dashboard is built with Next.js + React, using wagmi/viem for Base wallet interactions.
Real-time updates are powered by lightweight WebSockets, allowing creators to track campaign progress and reward status as it happens.

B. Partner Technologies & Why They Matter
Base: The low fees and high throughput make it practical to run thousands of micro-rewards on-chain. This is core to Dopamyn’s mission—instant, fair creator rewards at scale.
Cloudflare Workers: Used for edge-fast routing, authentication, and caching of campaign data.
AI Oracles using LLMs: Helps validate social actions and verify creator tasks when needed.

C. How Everything Works Together
A creator launches a campaign on Dopamyn.
User actions (tweets, likes, reposts, on-chain tasks) are tracked through our API.
Background processors compile eligible wallets and generate Merkle proofs.
A single batched contract call on Base settles rewards for all qualified participants.
Creators and users see real-time status updates on the dashboard.
